title: CIA-UAP-017, Placement on High Alert Due to Perceived Aggressive Foreign Posturing
what_is_it: A CIA report documenting a UFO sighting at Harare International Airport and the subsequent debate over whether it was a foreign reconnaissance device or extraterrestrial in origin.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text available — all facts derived from document metadata and the war.gov CSV description only.
The PDF appears to be scanned with poor OCR quality, so the full content of the report is not accessible for verification.
Single-source document with no corroborating reports referenced.
Redaction level assessed as heavy based on the absence of extractable text, though this may partly reflect OCR limitations rather than intentional redaction.
